title: New SSVEP frequencies, cards 8 to 14
question: What lets a decoder answer an SSVEP frequency it never trained on?

placement.card_order: the order of the consolidated handoff; cards 1 to 8 keep their numbers and anchors

metric_units: Accuracies, balanced accuracies, decision-change shares, pairwise win fractions and chance levels are proportions in [0,1]. An entry with unit "difference of proportions" is a paired difference, stored as a proportion: multiply by 100 for percentage points. Entries with unit "squared correlation" or "difference of squared correlations" (card 12’s gap G and residual R) are score units and never percentages. CPU component figures are milliseconds. Counts of people, windows, folds, rotations, fits, draws, calls and candidates are whole numbers. "no training" or "deterministic fit" stands where a trained level gives its seed count; null means not defined or not computed, never zero.
scope: Seven audited follow-ups to route 3 on SSVEP frequencies a decoder never trained on, cards 8 to 14 of the page. All seven use the BETA cohort route 3 studied; cards 10, 12, 13 and 14 also report Wearable-102, dry and wet. Card 8 gives the results of the cross-spectral round whose status card the earlier file carries. Each study block is read from its own audited aggregate and carries its own interval method. Seen and held-out results are separate tasks, reported side by side. Every figure compares set-ups on fixed splits.

release_record.decision: Publish the seven SSVEP follow-ups of this round as their audited aggregates, cards 8 to 14 of the new-SSVEP-frequencies page, outside every leaderboard.
release_record.rights: BETA keeps its released record: CC BY 4.0, cohort aggregates only, with participant consent described for noncommercial scientific research. Wearable-102 keeps its released record: CC BY 4.0, cohort aggregates only. Filter-bank CCA is credited to Chen et al. 2015; the code that ran is the project’s own SciPy realisation, and no code or weights are distributed.
release_record.research_release: Each study’s release approval approves an aggregate handoff and binds its aggregate, protocol and reviews by SHA-256; website publication rests on the owner’s decision D14.
release_record.binding: This record approves the served file the export audit names.

not_published: Per-person, per-fold, per-rotation, per-seed and per-window values of any kind, predictions, scores, features, fitted heads and the sealed run files: only cohort levels, paired contrasts with their intervals, gap statistics, decision-change shares, check counts and CPU component medians are published.
Per-frequency values of any kind, including the reference check’s candidate frequencies: the check is published as counts.
The cross-spectral per-seed MLP accuracies, the canary accuracies and the random-pairing accuracies of cards 8 and 9.
The fixed-decay retrospective gap-to-gain ratio table and its dry reconstruction.

All-trial decision counts: the harmonic-gap decision changes on BETA held-out are published as shares of the 11,200 decisions; the Wearable-102 decision changes and the fixed-decay and rising-weight transitions are not published.
The harmonic-gap Delta means and the margins against the strongest joint-CCA distractor.
Run times of whole evaluations and audits, memory and process identifiers; the CPU-time readings of the component measurements and every host, processor, system and runtime label.
Predictions from the comment thread on cards 8 to 14: each new card states its prespecified criteria only, and the thread’s prediction stays on card 4 of the released file.
The handoffs, protocols, freezes, receipts, reviews and approvals themselves: each is pinned by SHA-256 in the release manifest and checked by the export; several carry private storage paths.
